subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Where should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live before the linked implementation lands?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new persistent preference or config surface, and current docs explicitly say WebChat has no persisted config section.

options.title: Use scoped Control UI settings
options.body: Add the shortcut mode to existing scoped `UiSettings` and chat settings UI while keeping plain Enter as the default for existing users.

options.title: Add gateway config surface
options.body: Introduce a documented canonical config/schema setting only if operators need server-managed policy, with upgrade and doctor expectations covered.

options.title: Decline configurable core behavior
options.body: Keep current Enter-to-send behavior and rely on existing Shift+Enter newline behavior if maintainers do not want another settings surface.

recommendation.title: Use scoped Control UI settings
recommendation.body: Add the shortcut mode to existing scoped `UiSettings` and chat settings UI while keeping plain Enter as the default for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review context and recent Control UI chat history make this the strongest routing signal for the product/settings-scope choice.
